full_text: Consuming a corpse has a chance to spawn a health globe. | Unlocked at level 10. | Death finds a way.

Consuming a corpse increases your movement speed by {movement_speed_pct} for {duration_seconds} seconds. This effect can stack up to {max_stacks_count} times. | Unlocked at level 10. | "Few have dared to master the dark arts, but then, there are few like us." —Master Necromancer Ordan

Increase armor by {armor_pct:base}, reduced by {armor_pct:per_minion} for each active minion. | Unlocked at level 14. | "Solitude is the one constant for those who have chosen our path." —Master Necromancer Jostan

Bone Spear, Bone Spikes, and Bone Spirit have a {proc_chance_pct} chance to trap enemies in a Bone Prison for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 16. | What is flesh but a prison for bones?

Increase the attack speed of Bone Spikes, Siphon Blood, and Grim Scythe by {attack_speed_pct}. | Unlocked at level 20. | "I did not offer my life to this service in order to watch you fight enemies slowly." —Master Necromancer Leger
The Essence cost of Command Skeletons and the cooldown of Command Golem are reduced by {cooldown_reduction_pct}. | Unlocked at level 20. | One does not become a Priest of Rathma to lead the living.
Increase the duration of your Skeletal Mage and Revive minions by {duration_bonus_pct}. | Unlocked at level 24. | A good minion should stay around for a while.

Poison abilities also slow enemies by {slow_pct} and reduce their attack speed by {attack_speed_pct:enemy} for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 27. | "The point is not to perform the spell to meet expectations, but to defy them." —Deathspeaker Mykan
Increase your maximum Essence by {max_pool_resource}. | Unlocked at level 30. | Essence is the spark that illuminates all living things.
While using a scythe, gain {gain_pct} Essence and Life per kill. | Unlocked at level 31. | All apprentices train to use scythes, though they may come to favor other weapons later.
Receive a {damage_bonus_pct} damage bonus for each enemy afflicted by one of your curses. | Unlocked at level 38. | The more effective the curse, the better it is to share it.
Your curses cost {cost_reduction_pct} less Essence and last forever. | Unlocked at level 40. | It is said that being cursed is the most painful way to die.

When you take lethal damage, you are sustained preventing all damage for {duration_seconds} seconds. In addition, you heal for {heal_pct} of your Life per minion. This effect cannot occur more than once every {internal_cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 41. | "Our minions serve the Balance by serving us." —Deathspeaker Rahad

You are healed for {life_per_hit_share_pct} of your Life on Hit when one of your minions hits an enemy. | Unlocked at level 45. | "Those who are fearful of the dead have not spent much time around them. I find them to be quite dependable." —Master Necromancer Mehtan

Increases your Life regeneration by {life_regen_pct} for each enemy within {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 50. | "Our enemies must die, and we must stay alive. Altogether, we uphold the Balance." —Deathspeaker Jurdann

Bone Spikes, Bone Spear, and Bone Spirit deal {damage_bonus_pct} increased damage for every {distance_yards} yards from you, up to a maximum of {max_bonus_pct}. | Unlocked at level 55. | "Bones are sharp, but our wits are sharper." —Master Necromancer Ordan
Your minions gain {thorns_share_pct} of your Thorns. | Unlocked at level 64. | What comes up from the grave must bring enemies down.

Picking up a health globe removes the health cost of the next Blood spell. This effect can stack up to {max_stacks_count} times. | Unlocked at level 66. | In life or death, blood holds considerable power.

After cumulatively losing {life_lost_threshold_pct} of your maximum Life, all ability cooldowns are reduced by {cooldown_reduction_pct}. This effect cannot reduce an ability's cooldown more than once for each time that ability is used. | Unlocked at level 68. | Priests of Rathma may die as others do, but their lives are never wasted.

You cannot lose Life for {duration_seconds} seconds after using Land of the Dead, Army of the Dead, or Simulacrum. This effect cannot occur more than once every {internal_cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 70. | "Let the wisdom of Rathma protect us from those that would do us harm." —The Books of Kalan
